Message:
I ready my lance,
then thrust it towards
the pile of boulders.

They rumble and give way,
before light pours in
through where they once stood.
And then...

Fortina approaches me
with tears welling in her eyes,

when a snarling creature
appears behind her
and charges towards us...

I quickly pull Fortina
into my arms.

As the creature draws nearer,
I raise my lance,
and strike it down.

But, more and more creatures
come flooding into
the small cave,
completely surrounding us
in an instant.

“There’s no one better than you.
Your trust gives me
the strength to fight.

After all we’ve
been through together,
there’s no foe who can
stand a chance against us.”

That’s right.
I’m not fighting alone.
Fortina’s here too,
fighting side by side with me.

That’s why,
my resolve will bend no more!

“Yes, that is true.
The two of us together...
can overcome any trial!”
